series.name: R32 split FTXC-C user manual + ARC remote codes (PK-sold Sensira class)
series.notes: Daikin Room AC Operation Manual R32 Split FTXC-C (Sensira; FTXC50DV1B/FTXC60DV1B PK-sold class) + ARC remote code lists. High (official user manual). Model-scoped — separate file from K-Series service codes where digits diverge.

meaning.en: The drain/l level-sensing system reported a fault (pump units).
meaning.ur: Drain/level sensing system ne fault dikhaya hai (pump wali units mein).

causes.en: Drain clogged or drain pipe installed with upward slope.
causes.ur: Drain band (clog) ya drain pipe ooper ki taraf jhuki hui lagi hui hai

causes.en: Defective drain pump.
causes.ur: Drain pump kharab

causes.en: Defective float switch or short-circuited connector.
causes.ur: Float switch kharab ya connector mein short

solutions.en: Clear the drain and correct the pipe slope.
solutions.ur: Drain saaf kar lein aur pipe ka rukh theek kar lein

solutions.en: Replace the drain pump or float switch as diagnosed.
solutions.ur: Diagnosis ke mutabiq drain pump ya float switch badlein

notes.en: Mainly drain-pump models (cassette/floor); SM-TS3 lists same three causes.
notes.ur: Zyada tar drain-pump wali models (cassette/floor) mein; SM-TS3 mein bhi wohi teen causes listed hain.

title.en: Indoor heat exchanger (2) / gas pipe thermistor fault
title.ur: Indoor heat exchanger (2) / gas pipe thermistor kharab

meaning.en: The indoor gas-pipe (2nd coil) thermistor read open or short.
meaning.ur: Indoor gas pipe (doosra coil) ka thermistor khula ya short hai

causes.en: Defective connector contact on the thermistor.
causes.ur: Thermistor ka connector contact kharab

causes.en: Defective gas-pipe thermistor.
causes.ur: Gas pipe thermistor kharab

causes.en: Defective indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Indoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Reseat the connector and re-measure resistance.
solutions.ur: Connector dobara lagayein aur resistance phir nap lein.

solutions.en: Replace the thermistor, then the indoor PCB if the reading stays invalid.
solutions.ur: Thermistor badlein, phir bhi reading ghalat rahe to indoor PCB badlein

notes.en: Also in ARC433B/ARC466 remote cycles (SM-TS3 how-to-check, FTXS-K SM).
notes.ur: Yeh ARC433B/ARC466 remote cycles mein bhi hai (SM-TS3 how-to-check, FTXS-K SM).

title.en: Louver limit switch / front-panel motor error
title.ur: Louver limit switch / front-panel motor kharab

meaning.en: The airflow-louver (front panel) drive hit its limit switch incorrectly or the drive motor failed.
meaning.ur: Airflow louver (front panel) ka drive limit switch par galat ruka ya drive motor kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Defective front panel driving motor.
causes.ur: Front panel ka driving motor kharab

causes.en: Defective limit switch.
causes.ur: Limit switch kharab

solutions.en: Check louver mechanism for jamming; free it and retest.
solutions.ur: Louver mechanism jam to nahi, check karein; azaad karke dobara test karein

solutions.en: Replace the front-panel motor or limit switch.
solutions.ur: Front panel ka motor ya limit switch badlein

notes.en: FTXC-C wording 'Louver limit switch error'; SM-TS3 C7 'front panel driving motor fault'.
notes.ur: FTXC-C ki wording 'Louver limit switch error' hai; SM-TS3 mein C7 'aamle panel ka driving motor fault' hai.

meaning.en: The indoor humidity sensor circuit reported a fault.
meaning.ur: Indoor humidity sensor circuit ne fault dikhaya hai.

causes.en: Defective humidity sensor.
causes.ur: Humidity sensor kharab

causes.en: Defective connector contact.
causes.ur: Connector ka contact kharab

solutions.en: Reconnect the humidity sensor plug.
solutions.ur: Humidity sensor ka plug dobara lagayein

solutions.en: Replace the humidity sensor if the fault remains.
solutions.ur: Fault phir bhi rahe to humidity sensor badlein

notes.en: Also on web-manual RA list and Daikin India page wording 'FAULTY HUMIDITY SENSOR'.
notes.ur: Yeh web-manual RA list par bhi hai aur Daikin India page par wording 'FAULTY HUMIDITY SENSOR' hai.

meaning.en: The high-pressure switch opened, stopping the unit.
meaning.ur: High-pressure switch khul gaya aur unit band ho gayi.

causes.en: Dirty outdoor unit heat exchanger.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit ka heat exchanger ganda

causes.en: Clogged refrigerant piping.
causes.ur: Refrigerant piping mein blockage

causes.en: Defective high-pressure switch or loose connector contact.
causes.ur: High pressure switch kharab ya connector contact dhila

solutions.en: Wash the outdoor condenser and restore airflow.
solutions.ur: Outdoor condenser dhoyein aur airflow theek karein.

solutions.en: Clear piping restrictions; replace the HPS if it fails continuity checks.
solutions.ur: Piping ki rukaawat hatayein; HPS continuity test mein nakam rahe to use badlein

notes.en: SM-TS3 E3 supposed causes align; some outdoor units report E5/E3 differently per OM note.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein E3 ki causes milti hain; OM note ke mutabiq kuch outdoor units E5/E3 alag tarah report karte hain.

title.en: Operation halt due to compressor internal temperature
title.ur: Compressor ki andar ki temperature ki wajah se chalna ruka

meaning.en: The unit stopped because the compressor's internal temperature rose above the allowed limit.
meaning.ur: Unit ruk gaya kyunke compressor ki andar ki temperature mujarraba se upar chali gayi

causes.en: Compressor internal temperature exceeded the permitted threshold (sustained heavy load or poor heat rejection).
causes.ur: Compressor ki andar ki temperature ijazat ki had se upar chali gayi (lagatar bhaari load ya garmi nikalne mein kami)

causes.en: Conditions that overheat the compressor, such as low refrigerant, blocked condenser, or very hot ambient.
causes.ur: Compressor ko zyada garam karne wale hal, jaise refrigerant kam hona, condenser band hona, ya bahut tez garmi

solutions.en: Switch the unit off, let the compressor cool, remove airflow restrictions (filter/condenser), then restart.
solutions.ur: Unit band karein, compressor ko thanda hone dein, airflow ki raaste ki harkat hatayein (filter/condenser), phir restart karein

solutions.en: If the code returns, have a technician check refrigerant charge and compressor windings before running again.
solutions.ur: Agar code dobara aaye to technician se refrigerant charge aur compressor windings check karwa lein, phir chalaayein

notes.en: FTXC-C OM lists F8 as '-' (not defined for that model); wording taken from RA web-manual and FTXF user reference guide. No official cause list is published for F8 - causes are paraphrased.
notes.ur: FTXC-C OM mein F8 '-' (us model ke liye defined nahi) ke tor par listed hai; wording RA web-manual aur FTXF user reference guide se li gayi hai. F8 ke liye koi official cause list shuda hui nahi hai - causes parafrase ki gayi hain.

title.ur: Heat exchanger zyada garam ho gaya

meaning.en: The indoor heat exchanger temperature went above the safe limit and the unit stopped.
meaning.ur: Indoor heat exchanger ki temperature safe limit se upar chali gayi aur unit ruk gayi

causes.en: Reduced airflow across the indoor coil (clogged filter, dirty heat exchanger, blocked return air).
causes.ur: Indoor coil par airflow kam ho gaya (filter ghad hua, heat exchanger mila hua, return air band)

causes.en: Heat exchanger thermistor reading wrongly high (open/short or out of its characteristic range).
causes.ur: Heat exchanger thermistor ki reading ghalat mein zyada hai (khuli/short ya us ki characteristic range se bahar)

solutions.en: Clean the filter and indoor coil, confirm the fan runs at full speed, then restart.
solutions.ur: Filter aur indoor coil saaf karein, fan poori speed par chalta hai yeh confirm karein, phir restart karein

solutions.en: Measure the thermistor against the resistance-temperature chart and replace it if it is off-spec.
solutions.ur: Thermistor ko resistance-temperature chart ke mutabiq naap lein aur ghalat nikle to badlein

notes.en: The OM gives only the code name; no official cause list found. FA is position 34 in the ARC433B 33-code cycle (SM-TS3 how-to-check) and in the FTXS-K remote cycle.
notes.ur: OM mein sirf code ka naam diya hai; koi official cause list nahi mili. FA ARC433B 33-code cycle (SM-TS3 how-to-check) aur FTXS-K remote cycle mein position 34 par hai.

meaning.en: The high-pressure protection switch circuit is faulty (stuck open, broken wire, or bad contact).
meaning.ur: High pressure protection switch ka circuit kharab hai (khula atak hua, wire tooti, ya contact kharab)

causes.en: Defective high pressure switch.
causes.ur: High pressure switch kharab

causes.en: Broken wire or defective connector contact in the HPS circuit.
causes.ur: HPS circuit mein wire tooti ya connector ka contact kharab

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Test switch continuity and reseat or repair the connector wiring.
solutions.ur: Switch ki continuity test karein aur connector wiring dobara lagayein ya theek karein

solutions.en: Replace the HPS if it fails the test; replace the outdoor PCB only if the circuit itself is at fault.
solutions.ur: Test mein HPS kharab nikle to use badlein; outdoor PCB sirf tab badlein jab ghalti circuit mein khud ho

notes.en: Meaning from FTXC-C OM ('High pressure switch error'); causes from SM-TS3 H3 row. Distinct from E3, which is the actuation of the same switch.
notes.ur: Meaning FTXC-C OM se li gayi hai ('High pressure switch error'); causes SM-TS3 H3 row se hain. Yeh E3 se alag hai, jo usi switch ke khulne ka code hai.

title.ur: Liquid pipe thermistor short ya open

meaning.en: The liquid pipe (refrigerant circuit) temperature sensor read open or short.
meaning.ur: Liquid pipe (refrigerant circuit) ka temperature sensor khula ya short hai

causes.en: Defective connector contact on the thermistor.
causes.ur: Thermistor ka connector contact kharab

causes.en: Defective liquid pipe thermistor.
causes.ur: Liquid pipe thermistor kharab

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Reseat the connector and measure resistance against the temperature chart.
solutions.ur: Connector dobara baitha karein aur temperature chart ke mutabiq resistance naaphein

solutions.en: Replace the thermistor; replace the outdoor PCB only if the sensor tests good.
solutions.ur: Thermistor badlein; outdoor PCB sirf tab badlein jab sensor theek nikle

notes.en: Causes from SM-TS3 J8 row; FTXC-C OM provides the name only. Also on web-manual RA list.
notes.ur: Causes SM-TS3 J8 row se li gayi hain; FTXC-C OM sirf naam deta hai. Yeh web-manual RA list par bhi hai.

title.ur: Gas pipe thermistor short ya open

meaning.en: The gas pipe (refrigerant circuit) temperature sensor read open or short.
meaning.ur: Gas pipe (refrigerant circuit) ka temperature sensor khula ya short hai

causes.en: Defective connector contact on the thermistor.
causes.ur: Thermistor ka connector contact kharab

causes.en: Defective gas pipe thermistor.
causes.ur: Gas pipe thermistor kharab

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Reseat the connector and measure resistance against the temperature chart.
solutions.ur: Connector dobara baitha karein aur temperature chart ke mutabiq resistance naaphein

solutions.en: Replace the thermistor; replace the outdoor PCB only if the sensor tests good.
solutions.ur: Thermistor badlein; outdoor PCB sirf tab badlein jab sensor theek nikle

notes.en: Causes from SM-TS3 J9 row; FTXC-C OM provides the name only.
notes.ur: Causes SM-TS3 J9 row se li gayi hain; FTXC-C OM sirf naam deta hai.

title.en: Transmission error / check operation not executed
title.ur: Transmission error / check operation nahi chala

meaning.en: Either a signal transmission fault is flagged, or the periodic check (inspection) operation has not been run.
meaning.ur: Ya to signal transmission fault flag hua hai, ya periodic check (inspection) operation nahi chalaya gaya

causes.en: Check operation has not been executed for the required period (SM-TS3).
causes.ur: Zaroori arse tak check operation nahi chalaya gaya (SM-TS3).

causes.en: Transmission error on the remote-controller / unit signal path (FTXC-C naming).
causes.ur: Remote controller / unit ke signal path par transmission error (FTXC-C naming)

solutions.en: Run the check/inspection operation exactly as described in the manual and clear the code.
solutions.ur: Manual mein bataye tareeqe se check/inspection operation chalayein aur code khatam karein

solutions.en: If a real transmission fault remains, inspect the controller and inter-unit wiring for shorts, breaks and noise.
solutions.ur: Agar asli transmission fault baqi rahe to controller aur inter-unit wiring ko short, kata hua hissa aur shor ke liye check karein

notes.en: SM-TS3 U3 cause list contains only 'check operation is not executed'; FTXC-C OM names the code 'Transmission error'. Both official wordings kept.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein U3 ki cause list mein sirf 'check operation is not executed' hai; FTXC-C OM is code ko 'Transmission error' kehta hai. Dono official wordings rakhi gayi hain.

title.en: Piping & wiring installation mismatch / system not set
title.ur: Piping aur wiring ki installation ka mismatch / system set nahi hua

meaning.en: Piping/wiring does not match the commissioned system setting, the check operation was not executed, or the gas charge is insufficient.
meaning.ur: Piping/wiring commissioned system setting se match nahi karti, check operation nahi chalaya gaya, ya gas ki qadar kam hai.

causes.en: Improper connection of transmission wiring between indoor-outdoor and outdoor-outdoor units.
causes.ur: Wall unit-se-condenser unit aur condenser unit-se-condenser unit ke darmiyan transmission wiring ka connection ghalat hai

causes.en: Failure to execute the check operation after installation.
causes.ur: Installation ke baad check operation nahi chalaya gaya

causes.en: Wrong wiring or insufficient refrigerant gas (FTXC-C wording); defective indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Ghalat wiring ya kam refrigerant gas (FTXC-C ke alfaz yahi hain); kharab indoor unit PCB

solutions.en: Verify inter-unit piping and wiring against the installation manual and correct it.
solutions.ur: Installation manual ke mutabiq inter-unit piping aur wiring check karke ghalti theek karein

solutions.en: Run the check operation; leak-test and recharge if the gas is low.
solutions.ur: Check operation chalayein; gas kam ho to leak test karke dobara bharrein

solutions.en: Replace the indoor unit PCB only if the fault persists after wiring and charge are confirmed good.
solutions.ur: Wiring aur gas the hone ke baad bhi fault raha to indoor unit PCB badlein

notes.en: FTXC-C OM wording combined with SM-TS3 UF causes ('System is not set yet' / failure to execute check operation).
notes.ur: FTXC-C OM ki wording ko SM-TS3 UF causes ke sath milaya gaya hai ('System is not set yet' / check operation na chalna).

meaning.en: On multi-split RAC remotes: antifreeze protection operated in another indoor room. On SM-TS3 lines: system malfunction such as a closed stop valve or improper transmission wiring.
meaning.ur: Multi-split RAC remotes par: doosre indoor kamre mein antifreeze protection chala hai. SM-TS3 lines par: system kharabi, jaise band stop valve ya ghalat transmission wiring.

causes.en: Stop valve is not opened.
causes.ur: Stop valve khuli nahi hai

causes.en: Improper connection of transmission wiring between indoor-outdoor and outdoor-outdoor units.
causes.ur: Wall unit-se-condenser unit aur condenser unit-se-condenser unit ke darmiyan transmission wiring ka connection ghalat hai

causes.en: Antifreeze condition in another indoor room (restricted airflow); defective indoor or outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Doosre indoor kamre mein antifreeze ho gaya (airflow kam), ya indoor ya outdoor unit ka PCB kharab.

solutions.en: Fully open the stop valves and verify the inter-unit transmission wiring.
solutions.ur: Stop valves poori tarah kholein aur units ke darmiyan transmission wiring ki tasdeeq karein.

solutions.en: Clean filters and restore airflow in every indoor unit, then restart.
solutions.ur: Har indoor unit ke filter saaf karke airflow theek karein, phir restart karein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor/outdoor PCB if the code persists with wiring and airflow confirmed good.
solutions.ur: Wiring aur airflow theek hone ke baad bhi code aaye to wall ya condenser unit PCB badlein

notes.en: Two official wordings exist for UH: FTXC-C OM 'Antifreeze (other rooms)' (RAC multi-split) and SM-TS3 'Malfunction of system' (VRV/RA) - both recorded.
notes.ur: UH ke liye do official wordings hain: FTXC-C OM 'Antifreeze (other rooms)' (RAC multi-split) aur SM-TS3 'Malfunction of system' (VRV/RA) - dono record kar li gayi hain.

meaning.en: The optional electrical dust-collecting air cleaner reported a fault.
meaning.ur: Optional electrical dust-collecting air cleaner ne fault bataya hai

causes.en: Defect of the dust collecting element (dirty, shorted or misplaced collector).
causes.ur: Dust collecting element mein kharabi (ganda, short ya galat jagah par)

causes.en: Stained insulator part.
causes.ur: Insulator part par dagh lage hue hain.

causes.en: Defect of the high voltage power supply unit; defect of indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: High voltage power supply unit kharab hai; indoor unit PCB bhi kharab hai.

solutions.en: Clean or replace the dust collecting element and wipe the insulator.
solutions.ur: Dust collecting element saaf karein ya badlein aur insulator bhi saaf kar lein

solutions.en: Check the high voltage power supply output; replace the indoor PCB if the fault remains.
solutions.ur: High voltage power supply ka output check karein; fault uske baad bhi rahe to indoor PCB badlein

notes.en: Only on models fitted with the optional electrical air cleaner (FTXC-C OM lists AH; causes from SM-TS3 AH row; also ARC433B cycle position 33).
notes.ur: Sirf un models par jo optional electrical air cleaner ke sath aate hain (FTXC-C OM mein AH listed hai; causes SM-TS3 AH row se hain; ARC433B cycle position 33 par bhi).
